title: 第19章 黑狐妖第20章 以身相许
slug: 纯阳霸体绝美师尊求与我修炼
content_zh:
一道身影从清江镇内疯狂冲出。
苏铭身形一闪，轻松避开。
那人头也不回，边逃边好心大喊：“兄弟，赶紧逃啊！这地儿危险到爆，简直要命！”
苏铭目光投向清江镇，好家伙，镇中果然萦绕着大量黑气，诡异得一批。
“这啥情况？黑黢黢一片，怪渗人的。”苏铭内心纠结万分，“都到这儿了，总不能当逃兵吧？任务完不成，晋升正式弟子就彻底凉凉了。”
苏铭略一思索，转身如鬼魅般掠向那逃跑之人，一把将其摁住，急切问道：“喂，镇子里到底咋回事？快说！”
那人吓得脸色惨白，哆哆嗦嗦道：“大……大哥，镇子闹鬼啦！死了好多人，还有好多人中邪，跟疯了似的。就连来除妖的仙人，也都挂了。”
“仙人都折了？”苏铭眉头紧皱，“还有其他隐情不？”
因为紫云宗一般派发任务，会派发多份，所以有紫云宗的弟子，提前来了。
苏铭满心疑惑，本还想揪住那人再多问几句。
谁料，那厮竟眼皮一翻，直挺挺晕了过去。
“嘿，真晦气！”苏铭暗自嘟囔一声，无奈之下，只能转身，毅然朝清江镇内走去。
他心里可有十足的底气，那便是神级战法·雷霆万钧战法，此等逆天战法，对妖邪邪祟而言，堪称天敌，克制之力强大无匹。
苏铭深知，要想在这危机四伏之地站稳脚跟，必须先增强自身实力。
于是，他寻了个隐蔽之处，意念一动，整个人瞬间没入阴阳戒内。
此刻，他心中只有一个念头，将身上所有灵石一股脑儿掏出，准备全力提升雷霆万钧战法。
“成败在此一举，多些把握，遇到危险才能从容应对。”苏铭咬着牙，暗自给自己打气。
大半天时间悄然流逝，戒内灵气翻涌，苏铭沉浸在修炼之中。
身上的灵石与丹药，如同被黑洞吞噬一般，迅速消耗殆尽。
终于，在那灵气漩涡的中心，苏铭周身雷光闪烁，气势陡然一变。

“成了！”苏铭眼中闪过一抹狂喜，历经这番艰苦修炼，雷霆万钧战法已然成功提升至小成境界。
苏铭踏入清江镇。
刹那间，一团诡异黑气仿若嗅到血腥的恶狼，瞬间将他团团裹住。
“哼！”苏铭一声冷哼，那声音仿若来自九幽，满是不屑，“装神弄鬼之辈，还不速速现形！”
可那黑气仿若没听见一般，依旧张狂地在苏铭身周缠绕，好似在肆意挑衅。
“找死！”苏铭眼眸中寒芒一闪，抬手间，“雷霆降临！”
只见一道粗壮的雷光，仿若开天利剑，瞬间撕裂虚空，直直劈向那团黑气。
雷光所过之处，空间都好似被灼烧出一道道裂痕。
“轰！”一声巨响，黑气瞬间被湮灭。
一个被雷光焦糊的身影，如断线风筝般坠落。
苏铭定睛一看，好家伙，竟是一只黑狐妖！
“原来如此！”苏铭心中豁然开朗，“这清江镇哪是什么闹鬼，分明就是狐妖在作祟。”
“既然如此，那就简单了。”苏铭嘴角勾起一抹冷笑。
他大手一挥，直接将黑狐妖的妖核取了出来，那妖核散发着淡淡的幽光。
随后，苏铭身形一闪，如鬼魅般朝着镇子最中心奔去。
content_en:
A figure rushed out from Qingjiang Town.
Su Ming dodged and easily avoided it.
The man didn't look back, and shouted kindly as he ran away: "Brother, run away quickly! This place is extremely dangerous, it's life-threatening!"
Su Ming set his sights on Qingjiang Town. Good guy, there was indeed a lot of black energy lingering in the town, which was quite strange.
"What's going on here? It's so dark and weird." Su Ming was very confused in his heart. "We're all here now, so we can't just be deserters, right? If we can't complete the mission, we'll be completely devastated if we're promoted to a full-fledged disciple."
Su Ming thought for a moment, turned around and swooped towards the fleeing man like a ghost, held him down, and asked urgently: "Hey, what's going on in this town? Tell me!"
The man's face turned pale with fright, and he trembled: "Brother...brother, this town is haunted! Many people have died, and many others have been possessed by evil spirits, as if they are crazy. Even the immortals who came to exorcise the demons have died."
"All the immortals are broken?" Su Ming frowned, "Is there any other secret?"
Because the Ziyun Sect usually distributes multiple tasks, some disciples from the Ziyun Sect came in advance.
Su Ming was filled with doubts and wanted to grab the man and ask him a few more questions.
Unexpectedly, the guy rolled his eyelids and fainted.
"Hey, what a bad luck!" Su Ming muttered to himself. In desperation, he could only turn around and walk resolutely towards Qingjiang Town.
He has full confidence in his heart, and that is the god-level combat method, the Thunderous Combat Technique. This kind of heaven-defying combat method is a natural enemy for evil spirits, and its power of restraint is unparalleled.
Su Ming knew very well that in order to gain a foothold in this crisis-ridden place, he must first strengthen his own strength.
So, he found a hiding place, and with a thought, his whole body instantly fell into the Yin and Yang Ring.
At this moment, he had only one thought in his mind, which was to take out all the spirit stones on his body and prepare to improve the Thunderous Combat Technique with all his strength.
"Success or failure depends on one move. Be more sure and be able to deal with danger calmly." Su Ming gritted his teeth and encouraged himself secretly.
Most of the day passed quietly, the spiritual energy in the ring surged, and Su Ming was immersed in cultivation.
The spiritual stones and elixirs on his body were quickly consumed as if swallowed by a black hole.
Finally, in the center of the spiritual energy vortex, lightning flashed around Su Ming's body, and his aura suddenly changed.
"It's done!" A flash of ecstasy flashed in Su Ming's eyes. After this arduous training, the Thunderous Combat Technique has been successfully upgraded to the level of minor success.
Su Ming stepped into Qingjiang Town.
In an instant, a strange black air enveloped him like a wolf smelling blood.
"Hmph!" Su Ming snorted coldly, the voice seemed to come from Jiuyou, full of disdain, "Those who are pretending to be gods and ghosts, why don't you show up quickly!"
But the black energy seemed not to have heard it, and was still winding around Su Ming crazily, as if it was provoking him wantonly.
"Seeking death!" A cold light flashed in Su Ming's eyes, and he raised his hand, "Thunder is coming!"
I saw a thick bolt of lightning, like a sharp sword splitting the sky, tearing through the void in an instant and striking straight at the black air.
Wherever the lightning passed, the space seemed to be burned with cracks.
"Boom!" There was a loud noise, and the black energy was instantly annihilated.
A figure scorched by lightning fell like a kite with a broken string.
Su Ming took a closer look and saw that this good guy was actually a black fox demon!
"So that's it!" Su Ming suddenly understood, "This Qingjiang Town is haunted. It's clearly the fox demon who is causing trouble."
"In that case, it's easy." A sneer appeared on Su Ming's lips.
With a wave of his hand, he directly took out the black fox demon's demon core. The demon core exuded a faint light.
Then, Su Ming flashed and ran towards the center of the town like a ghost.
